the D3/D5/D7 system is a promising holographic model to describe QCD-like phase diagram features.

the baryonic sector of holographic QCD is sensitive to the confinement properties of the model.

the baryonic sector can play a crucial role in holographic models of QCD, even when the model is not designed for that purpose.
